items.stem: Which activities primarily occur in Stage 2 in the referenced sales motion?

options.text: Only renewal pricing negotiations.
Contract signature and booked revenue recognition.
Visioning and DITL use case mapping.
Production incident remediation.

items.stem: A workshop happened but no priorities or owners were captured. What is the right action?

options.text: Resolve the missing evidence before claiming the gate is complete.
Move the stage because the meeting occurred.
Invent plausible priorities in the CRM.
Launch a pilot to discover the priorities later.

items.stem: What is a core Stage 3 decision?

options.text: Authorize all future custom development.
Prove that procurement is automatically complete.
Confirm executive sponsorship, success criteria and the validation path.
Choose the slide theme for a generic demo.

items.stem: Which Blueprint artifact most directly supports the Metrics dimension of MEDDPICCS?

options.text: An unverified list of competitor logos.
A metric card with definition, baseline plan, target, source and owner.
A generic product overview.
A meeting invite without notes.

items.stem: A strong use case lacks a baseline owner. Which recovery is best?

options.text: Ignore the issue if the demo is impressive.
Restart every workshop with a larger audience.
Use an industry average as the measured customer baseline.
Assign the customer data owner and a focused measurement-design action.

items.stem: A sponsor accepts value, but security and signing authority are unresolved. How should the MAP treat them?

options.text: Mark them complete because value was accepted.
Separate workstreams with named owners, dependencies and decision dates.
Hide them until after deployment.
Assign them to the AI drafting tool without review.

items.stem: Which statement about the referenced CRM stages is safest to publish to partners?

options.text: Older enablement decks override the live process.
Teach the business gates and revalidate dated internal labels and navigation.
Every current Salesforce field is permanently fixed.
A partner may self-approve any internal stage gate.

items.stem: Who should resolve a missing sponsor path before expensive validation work?

options.text: The customer support queue alone.
The SCORM runtime automatically.
The account team, with AE ownership of sponsor access and qualification.
The learner by inventing an Economic Buyer.
